title: Tony’s optional idea bank — notes supplied by Sean, October 17 and 20, 2026
status: Every item optional and unapproved; documentation only, not a requirement or roadmap commitment
source_attribution: Tony’s brainstorming supplied by Sean on2026-10-17 and2026-10-20; screenshot wording visually verified. Sean’s separate tentative stats interest was relayed by Project Manager.
authority: No implementation, rebalance, artwork, audio production or new playable-character authorization follows from this bank.
Current Tony/Sean-only player-facing roster constraint remains; Josh/helper are speculative source notes only.
Existing approved character identities, weapons and creature records take precedence. Similarity is not evidence of approval or integration.

Later explicit approvals must be tracked separately with their own evidence. This optional source catalog neither authorizes them nor cancels separately approved work, including the subsequently requested transforming roach mini-boss.
consultation_rule: When matching feature work is discussed, consult relevant tagged ideas and ask Sean whether he wants one included. Offer a relevant suggestion/question; do not automatically implement or repeatedly recite the whole bank.
